title: rosa × dumetorum subvar. trichoidea
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subvar. trichoidea, commonly known as Trichosepala, is a rare and lesser-known species of rose plant. Trichosepala is known for its unique trichomatous sepals, giving it a distinctive appearance. The plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of Trichosepala include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antispasmodic effects.
